title: Hand-painted pathing (.w3proj/pathing.json)
description: The Pathing tool's overrides, written by app/src/lib/terrain/resize.ts (pathingOverridesText) and checked by validPathingOverrides; crates/w3proj/src/terrain_pathing.rs reads and writes the same file for a split terrain. Keys of its own are allowed and kept by the app; a split terrain can't keep them (it refuses the file then).

format.description: missing in files of older versions

width.description: the pathing map in cells: 4 per tile, (corners - 1) * 4; a file for another size is not used

height.description: the pathing map in cells: 4 per tile, (corners - 1) * 4

cells.description: one override per cell: [x, y, set, clear], the pathing bits the cell gets and loses ((cell | set) & ~clear)

prefixItems.description: x, in cells from the west
y, in cells from the south
set: the bits the cell gets
clear: the bits the cell loses
